entries.title: Operating advanced scientific instruments with AI agents that learn on the job (CALMS)
entries.note: Published as npj Comput Mater 12, 160 (2026), doi:10.1038/s41524-026-02005-0. Argonne CALMS agent operating an X-ray nanoprobe beamline plus an autonomous robotic materials station; orchestrates multistep workflows, interprets multimodal data, learns on the job via in-context expert guidance.

entries.title: A hardware-safety-gated system for LLM-written native ARTIQ control code on a trapped-ion platform (artiq-mcp)
entries.note: Duke Quantum Center + UMD (Wang, Qi, Xie, Linke, Brown). LLM agent (Claude Opus 4.8) that autonomously writes native ARTIQ control code and runs it on real trapped-ion quantum hardware, gated by a per-call hardware safety filter (token authorization via dax.sim simulation + per-device bounds). Agent autonomously built a full calibration stack on a co-trapped 40Ca+/40CaOH+ crystal and closed a cross-instrument magnetic-field-stabilization loop; portability confirmed on an independent 171Yb+ system. 1932 adversarial red-team scripts mapped the safety filter boundary. Open source: gitlab.oit.duke.edu/dw346/artiq_mcp.

entries.title: ARIA: A Causal-Aware Framework for Rescuing LLM Reasoning in Trustworthy Materials Discovery
entries.note: Johns Hopkins (Cao, Wang, Chen, Van Durme, Yuille, Clancy). Published at CIKM 2026 (doi:10.1145/3770855.3818954). Causal-aware framework for LLM-driven materials discovery that conditions knowledge use on Process-Structure-Property (PSP) mechanistic completeness via a three-tier cascade (direct causal reasoning when full PSP evidence chains exist; physics-informed analogical transfer for sparse/novel systems; explicit parametric fallback). Diagnoses 'contextual tunneling' where KG-augmented LLMs over-anchor on narrow retrieved evidence and suppress global physical reasoning. Built a 2,839-relation PSP knowledge graph from peer-reviewed literature; evaluated on forward-prediction and inverse-design tasks for 2D materials, with gains from online literature-search enrichment and auditable causal traces. Open source: github.com/yicao-elina/ARIA.

entries.title: From Literature to Hypotheses: An AI Co-Scientist System for Biomarker-Guided Drug Combination Hypothesis Generation
entries.note: CoDHy. Hannover Medical School (PLRI/CAIMed) + Sanford Burnham Prebys (Younis, Basak, Chavez, Ahmadi). Human-in-the-loop AI co-scientist for biomarker-guided cancer drug-combination hypothesis generation; Graph-RAG over a task-specific KG (Neo4j) with Node2Vec embeddings + Llama-3.1-8B validation/ranking agents. Benchmark-only (7 oncology scenarios). Code: github.com/baksho/CoDHy.

entries.title: AIMS: An uncertainty-aware AI experimentalist for quantum matter
entries.note: Stanford (Shen, Ji) + MIT, UT Austin, U. Florida, Boston College, SIMES/SLAC. Uncertainty-aware closed-loop AI experimentalist driving a cryogenic microwave impedance microscope on twisted bilayer MoSe2; three nested loops (navigation under uncertain perception, measurement selection under sample inhomogeneity, scale-resolved mechanism attribution). Real instrument, real quantum-matter samples.

entries.title: OmniQEC: discovering practical quantum error-correcting codes by an AI scientist
entries.note: NTU Singapore (Yan, Du) + Tokyo Univ. Agriculture & Technology, Zhejiang Univ. Technology, CityU Hong Kong, Hon Hai (Foxconn) Research. LLM orchestrator coordinating code generation, code-level screening, syndrome-extraction synthesis, and decoder-based circuit evaluation; self-evolving reasoning with slow-fast synergistic search. Discovered qLDPC codes outperforming BB [[72,12,6]] and [[144,12,12]] baselines under matched physical-qubit budgets.

entries.title: Agentic AI-enabled discovery across large-scale sleep physiology (AI Sleep Co-Scientist)
entries.note: Stanford (Thapa, Mignot, Zou) + DTU, Danish Center for Sleep Medicine, WashU, Together AI. Expert-guided environment with specialist agents for hypothesis development, signal preprocessing, and statistical analysis over ~124,000 polysomnography recordings / >50 TB across four cohorts; each result linked to executable code. Findings include diminished sleep network coupling associated with incident Parkinson's (HR 1.48) and Alzheimer's (HR 1.38).

entries.title: NVAITC AI Scientist (NAIS): A Governed End-to-End Research System - A Hypertension GWAS Case Study
entries.note: NVIDIA AI Technology Center + China Medical University Hospital (Taichung), RIKEN IMS. Governed agentic research system integrating proposal review, execution planning, governed computational routing, reproducible workflow orchestration, evidence generation, and scientist-in-the-loop oversight under an aggregate-only data policy. Validated on a hypertension GWAS with hospital-linked genotype/EHR data from 286,422 individuals; reproduced FGF5, ATP2B1, CNNM2, FTO, GRB14 loci.

entries.title: CogEEGAgent: Toward Autonomous Cognitive EEG Analysis with Grounded Execution and Selection-Aware Verification
entries.note: Tohoku University (Hou, Yamada) + Texas A&M, WPI. Cognitive-EEG analysis agent grounded in MNE-Python; scientific harness separates semantic from scientific authority so the LLM proposes registered analyses while deterministic components validate typed contracts, gate confirmation-set access, and authorize evidence-bound release. Evaluated on a prespecified routing benchmark and an outcome-blind, externally model-authored campaign. Code: github.com/dengzhe-hou/CogEEGAgent.

entries.title: Expert-Guided LLM Reasoning for Battery Discovery: From AI-Driven Hypothesis to Synthesis and Characterization (ChatBattery)
entries.note: Universite de Montreal / Mila (Liu, Ai, Bengio) + Oxford, UCL, University of Ottawa, NRC Canada. arXiv v1 2025-07-21. Agentic framework that integrates domain knowledge to steer LLM chain-of-thought reasoning in materials design. Complete design-to-synthesis-to-characterization cycle: identified, synthesized, and characterized three novel lithium-ion cathode materials with practical capacity improvements of 28.8%, 25.2%, and 18.5% over LiNi0.8Mn0.1Co0.1O2 (NMC811).

entries.title: Validation of an LLM-based Multi-Agent Framework for Protein Engineering in Dry Lab and Wet Lab (TourSynbio-Agent)
entries.note: Toursun Synbio (Shanghai) + City University of Hong Kong, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Johns Hopkins. arXiv v1 2024-11-09. Couples the protein-specialized multimodal LLM TourSynbio-7B with domain-specific deep learning models for computational and experimental protein engineering. Five case studies: three dry-lab (mutation prediction, protein folding, protein design) and two wet-lab validations engineering P450 proteins with up to 70% improved selectivity for steroid 19-hydroxylation and reductases with 3.7x enhanced catalytic efficiency for alcohol conversion.

entries.title: Hierarchical Multi-agent Large Language Model Reasoning for Autonomous Functional Materials Discovery (MASTER)
entries.note: Los Alamos National Laboratory Theoretical Division (Matanovic, Holby, Kort-Kamp) + University of Connecticut (Rothfarb, Davis, Li). arXiv v1 2025-12-15, cond-mat.mtrl-sci. Materials Agents for Simulation and Theory in Electronic-structure Reasoning: an active learning framework where LLMs autonomously design, execute, and interpret atomistic simulations, translating natural language into density functional theory workflows. Hierarchy of reasoning strategies (single-agent baseline plus peer review, triage-ranking, triage-forms). Across CO adsorption on Cu-surface transition-metal adatoms and on M-N-C catalysts, reasoning-driven exploration reduces required atomistic simulations by up to 90% relative to trial-and-error selection.

entries.title: Claw AI Lab: An Autonomous Multi-Agent Research Team
entries.note: Nanyang Technological University (Wu, Lin) + A*STAR, Moxin Technology, NUIST, Tsinghua, USTC. arXiv v1 2026-05-21. Lab-native autonomous research platform that advances automated research from a hidden prompt-to-paper pipeline into an interactive AI laboratory: users instantiate a full research team from one prompt with customizable roles, collaborative workflows, real-time monitoring, artifact inspection, and rollback/resume through a unified dashboard; research modes for exploration, multi-agent discussion, and reproduction. Claw-Code Harness connects local codebases, datasets, and checkpoints to runnable experiments and feeds execution artifacts back into the research loop. Internal evaluation on five AI research case studies using AutoResearchClaw as baseline; preferred by AI expert judges on idea novelty, experiment completeness, and paper presentation quality. Code: github.com/Claw-AI-Lab/Claw-AI-Lab.

entries.title: SR-Scientist: Scientific Equation Discovery With Agentic AI
entries.note: Shanghai Jiao Tong University + Shanghai Innovation Institute + GAIR (Xia, Sun, Liu). arXiv v2 2026-02-17; published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026. Elevates the LLM from a simple equation proposer inside a genetic-programming search to an autonomous agent that writes code to analyze data, implements the equation as code, submits it for evaluation, and optimizes based on experimental feedback, using a code interpreter wrapped as data-analysis and equation-evaluation tools over a long horizon with minimal human-defined pipelines. Outperforms baselines by an absolute 6-35% on datasets covering four science disciplines; also reports robustness to noise, out-of-domain generalization, symbolic accuracy, and an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework.
